newsitem.title: USA: Intercargo to sell Kingsway Financial stake.
newsitem.headline: Intercargo to sell Kingsway Financial stake.

text.p: Intercargo Corp said Wednesday it plans to sell substantially all of its common shares of Kingsway Financial Services Inc.
The company currently holds 4.2 million Kingsway common shares, of which 4.1 million are expected to be sold in the offering, Intercargo said.
The net proceeds will be used to repay the principal balance of the company's bank line of credit and for business development purposes and to provide working capital, Intercargo said.
The securities offering is expected to be completed by the end of August 1997, the company said.

The Kingsway shares will not be, and have not been, registered under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933 and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration, or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements of that act, the company said.
